**[[Bangladesh Police|Police]] fire tear gas and rubber bullets at students and professors occupying [[Dhaka University]] in [[Dhaka]], [[Bangladesh]], to protest against the ruling [[Awami League]] party and its [[Government of Bangladesh|government]] job quotas. *Archaeologists unearth remains of a [[medieval]] [[papal]] palace in the square outside the [[Archbasilica of Saint John Lateran]] in [[Rome]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/remains-ancient-papal-palace-believed-have-been-found-rome-2024-07-17/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[European Union]] [[General Court (European Union)|General Court]] dismisses [[ByteDance]]'s lawsuit against the [[European Commission]]'s designation of the company as a "[[Market domination|gatekeeper]]" under the [[Digital Markets Act]], citing ByteDance's significant global [[market value]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Effects of Hurricane Beryl in Texas]]
***The confirmed death toll from [[Hurricane Beryl]] in [[Texas]], [[United States]], increases to 22, with several deaths in the [[Greater Houston]] area caused by [[heat illness]] due to prolonged power outages amid an ongoing [[2024 North America heat waves|heat wave]]. [https://www.npr.org/2024/07/17/nx-s1-5043279/beryl-houston-repair-crews-face-threats-still-without-power (NPR)] [https://www.fox26houston.com/news/beryl-death-toll-houston-fallen-trees-flooding-fire (KRIV-TV)]
*At least 16 people are killed in a fire at a shopping mall in [[Zigong]], [[Sichuan]], [[China]]. [https://apnews.com/article/china-fire-zigong-mall-2a7bb2481a98e7daa1d6e2230a1e7325 (AP)]
*[[Comoros]]-flagged [[Oil tanker|oil tanker]] Prestige Falcon capsizes off the coast of [[Oman]]. The [[Indian Navy]] rescues nine crew members, with seven others missing. [https://apnews.com/article/oman-india-oil-tanker-capsize-55658e125f6b56776190211584f86e4a (AP)]
*At least six people are killed by storms in [[Brest Region|Brest]], [[Gomel Region|Gomel]], and [[Mogilev Region]]s, [[Belarus]]. [https://apnews.com/article/belarus-storm-damage-cebfd1d983156b9b9e38e05c7dd839c8 (AP)]

*[[2024 European heatwaves]]
**[[Italy|Italian]] authorities place thirteen cities throughout the [[Italian Peninsula]] under rare [[Excessive heat warning|severe heat warnings]] due to predicted [[Heat index|heat indexes]] reaching as high as 44°C (111.2°F) throughout the week. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Eugenics in Japan]] 
**[[Prime Minister of Japan|Japanese Prime Minister]] [[Fumio Kishida]] formally apologizes to 130 victims of forced [[Sterilization (medicine)|sterilization]] under the Eugenics Protection Law which was declared unconstitutional on July 3, and approves compensation measures for more than 25,000 affected victims and their relatives. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20240717_20/ (NHK)]
*[[Prime Minister of Spain|Spanish Prime Minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] announces measures to reduce the spread of [[Fake news|fake news]] and [[Hate speech|harmful content]] in all forms of media, which the [[People's Party (Spain)|People's Party]] claims is an act to [[Censorship|censor]] and control critical media. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/spain-proposes-tightening-rules-media-tackle-fake-news-2024-07-17/ (Reuters)]
